EM-17
ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE)  -  TIMING BELT

SST
A02560

10.  REMOVE CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS
Using SST, remove the pulley bolt. Remove the 2 timing pulleys.
    SST    09960-10010  (09962-01000,  09963-01000)

A/T
P11764                                Z16729

11.  A/T:
         DISCONNECT OIL COOLER TUBES
Remove the 2 bolts and hose clamps, and disconnect oil cooler tubes.

SST
S00267

12.  REMOVE CRANKSHAFT PULLEY
(a)  Using SST, loosen the pulley bolt.
         SST   09213-70010,  09330-00021
(b)  Remove the pulley bolt.

SST
S00404

(c)  Using SST, remove the pulley.
         SST   09950-50010  (09951-05010,  09952-05010,
                               09953-05010,  09953-05020,  09954-05030)

A02564

13.  REMOVE NO.1 TIMING BELT COVER
Remove the 5 bolts, timing belt cover and gasket.
14.  REMOVE TIMING BELT GUIDE
